full_script: Imagine waking up every morning to a cup of coffee that isn't just a beverage, but a personal health assistant that understands exactly what your body needs. Welcome to Zenith C—the world's first AI-integrated smart brewing cup. By syncing biometric data directly from your smartwatch, Zenith C analyzes your previous night's sleep quality to automatically adjust the perfect amount of caffeine extraction, ensuring you reach peak alertness without any jitters or crashes. Simply drop a specialty pod into the base, and the Auto-Brew system will heat the water and brew your coffee in just 45 seconds, maintaining a perfect 65°C (149°F) for up to 12 hours thanks to its advanced Nano-Ceramic core. Best of all, with its 100% leak-proof magnetic valve design, you can confidently toss the Zenith C into your backpack or place it right next to your laptop without worrying about a single drop spilling. Don't let fatigue hold back your day; upgrade your daily routine and energize smarter with Zenith C.
